answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the ripple graph. Re-attestations are stored in vertex and plume lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, which means holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 948 impostors cost 1126 times the honest price and take 7 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
